purpose: Verify natural target-KV DSpark P/D request retraction, exact all-layer CPU restore, failed-capture retirement and post-exit Mooncake readback
draft: Synthetic target-KV DSpark draft; biased token-100 serving requests are correctness fixtures, not quality evidence
transport: Real Mooncake TCP KV transfer and Store

resources.temporary_image_adjustment: Uninstalled system flashinfer-cubin 0.6.12 and flashinfer-jit-cache 0.6.12+cu130 to use the shared FlashInfer 0.6.17 environment

config.batching_barrier: Only test-tagged initial requests wait for four; resumed requests bypass it

assertions: Natural pool exhaustion completes every request; per-stage retraction metrics equal summed per-request retractions.
Every local target layer K/V exactly equals an independent pre-offload copy after CPU-to-GPU restore into newly allocated slots.
All stages rebuild an empty projected draft context through the restored prefix.
The first-retraction capture IDs recorded at handoff agree across ranks, reach Catalog FAILED and never publish.
Capture context/finalizer detach on restore and the attempted marker remains set.
Only survivors and a fresh post-pressure request publish; source KV, raw teacher top-128 logits/IDs, LSE, token IDs, masks, positions and terminal validity pass.
All selected successful snapshots are fully reread with object digest and content validation after both producer process trees exit.
limitations: Qwen3-0.6B and a synthetic draft only
TCP and a test Catalog; no production retention or pressure-specific RDMA certification
No combined TP/PP or asymmetric P/D pressure coverage
Device KV pool exhaustion, not optional P/D KV offload manager or HiCache host-tier pressure
Test observers copy and synchronize tensors; no throughput, latency or trained-draft quality claims

normal_and_hidden_regressions.difference: Ran before the pressure-only capture-ID handoff observer and peer-failure assertion refinement. These suites use no pressure-tagged requests. All production sources and shared launch defaults match final sources.

earlier_attempts.reason: Initial fixture had no all-layer restore observer and did not wait for four asynchronous capture leases; overlap graph admitted 3/4 captures.
All-layer restore observation passed eager; graph again exposed 3/4 admission before the lease-readiness wait.
Both PP2 modes passed exact restore before adding explicit failed-Catalog-lease checks.
All PP1 modes passed with startup readiness and Catalog checks; final pressure-only capture-ID observation timing is rerun separately.

PP2 graph recorded two peer_capture_failed events on rank 0 after peer retraction. The fixture incorrectly required two local request_aborted_or_retracted events. Final checks retain exact failure totals and explicit original Catalog lease checks, independent of rank ordering.
